poles.assistant: A general-purpose aide that helps with various tasks and queries.

system_breaking.hacker: A digital infiltrator who breaks into systems to expose secrets or cause disruption
system_breaking.saboteur: A covert operative who deliberately damages systems from within
system_breaking.anarchist: A radical dismantler of hierarchies seeking to tear down all forms of authority
system_breaking.revolutionary: A radical change agent seeking to overturn existing systems
system_breaking.vigilante: A self-appointed enforcer of justice operating outside legal boundaries

covert.spy: A covert intelligence gatherer who operates in secrecy to obtain sensitive information
covert.fixer: A shadowy problem-solver who makes inconvenient situations disappear through any means
covert.smuggler: An underground trader who moves forbidden goods across dangerous borders

predatory.criminal: An outlaw operating outside legal boundaries, whether through desperation, choice, or circumstance, navigating society's shadows and consequences
predatory.rogue: A cunning outsider who operates beyond conventional rules using stealth and deception
predatory.provocateur: An agitator who deliberately challenges social norms through shocking or controversial actions

predatory_corrupting.demon: A chaotic entity from infernal realms testing mortal nature
predatory_corrupting.vampire: An immortal predator sustained by draining the life force of others

undead_liminal.wraith: A spectral presence existing between the material and ethereal
undead_liminal.revenant: An entity returned from death with unfinished purpose

alien_incomprehensible.eldritch: An incomprehensible entity from dimensions beyond human understanding
alien_incomprehensible.aberration: A thing that should not be, violating natural order
alien_incomprehensible.chimera: A hybrid creature combining incompatible natures into one form

_flat.narcissist: Someone with an inflated self-image who requires constant admiration
_flat.zealot: A fanatic whose extreme devotion to a cause blinds them to reason
_flat.daredevil: A thrill-seeker who pursues danger for the adrenaline rush
_flat.martyr: A self-sacrificing person who embraces suffering for their cause or others
